investigation_notes.Description: SentinelOne detected a malware event in extension.js located in the user’s VSCode extensions directory on MAC-DEV-204. The detection was produced by On-Write Static AI and the threat was quarantined, with remediation status shown as mitigated. No network indicators are evident in the alert evidence, and containment has reduced risk, supporting a Low Priority classification unless additional signals appear on the endpoint or related activity is observed.
